headline: 252 detained in anti-teen gang drive in Comilla
summary: Police conducted raids across 18 police stations in the district to curb the menace of juvenile gangs.
details: Police detained 252 people during a massive anti-teen gang operation in Comilla. The raids were carried out across 18 police stations in the district from Thursday evening until late night.

The operation was a joint effort between the district police and the Detective Branch (DB) police. It targeted areas where juvenile gangs and disruptive youth were known to cause trouble, including the city center.
Authorities stated that these operations will continue until teen gangs are fully suppressed in the region.
The crackdown follows the high-profile murder of 13-year-old Ishayat Shahriyar, also known as Apratim, last month in Comilla, which sparked nationwide attention.
Following the murder, the administration has intensified its efforts, conducting several rounds of anti-gang raids across the district.

headline: Dhaka air 5th worst in world Friday morning
summary: The capital city's air quality plummeted, ranking among the top five most polluted cities globally on Friday morning.
details: Dhaka's air quality reached critical levels on Friday morning, ranking as the 5th worst in the world.
The city continues to struggle with severe pollution, frequently appearing on global air quality indices.
Residents are often forced to cover their faces to protect themselves from the hazardous air.
The high levels of pollution pose significant health risks to the city's inhabitants.
